items.title: Bernard Steinau Interview, 1983-05-28
items.q: Interviewer mentions Ralston was there and ate shrimp with Raymond and Ralston; Interviewee does not claim personal interaction with Ralston, only responds to the interviewer's narrative.

ctx.x: You don't remember when that was. That would have been in, yes, I can. I do remember. That would probably have been in, after the first of the year, well, let's say spring of 1950. 1950 would be my guess. And who were they auditioning for? I don't know who it was. They were auditioning for somebody. It may have just been that they were auditioning for you and Oren, maybe. I don't think so. There was somebody they were auditioning for, but I don't remember the name. I think they auditioned once for Myron. That may…
Ralston was there one time when they auditioned. Sounds right. And, of course, he was always taking pictures. When he had any opportunity, he was dedicated to that.

When you went to Lulee White's, did you get any pieces of marrow? No. I got, I think, two pieces, two small panes, about four by four inches. Of very fancy bathroom window glass. And some pieces of wallpaper. Mm-hmm. Still have both. Yeah.
